text:
anya: quick sync  final call on response envelope for GA. customers want explicit billing units + stable traces.
chris: propose top-level minimal shape: request_id, trace_id, model, usage, billing_units, result.
devon: usage -> tokens_total/prompt/completion. optional usage.per_message gated by param expand_token_breakdown=true (size caps).
pm_jordan: launch musts: SDKs (py/ts) updated, migration guide, console telemetry, legal signoff on retention/PII.
sre_maya: trace format: prefix rwd- + hex. enforce x-rw-trace header and include trace_id in access logs. sampling: 100% errors, 1% successes.
chris: tool-calls under result.tools with stdout/structured and content_digest for big blobs. rerank as result.rerank.items [{item_id,score,normalized_score,metadata}].
devon: add billing_units_type string and billing_units float so finance doesn't need to infer. include mapping table in PR.
infra-bot: canary flag usage_envelope_v1 scheduled 2024-11-06T09:00Z on canary-2.
anya: actions: chris/devon to draft schema PR + examples for chat/completion/embedding/rerank/tools; pm_jordan update comms/playbook; sre_maya update logging. follow-up next Tue.
pm_jordan: if no objections, mark priority=high for next sprint. :white_check_mark:
